name: Commission and First-Time Buyer
templateText: Hi {{senderName}}! Great questions. Our standard commission rate is 5-6% of the sale price, split between the buyer's and seller's agents. We also offer a complimentary buyer consultation at no obligation. Would you like to set one up?

name: Relocation Assistance
templateText: Hi {{senderName}}! Welcome — we'd be happy to help with your relocation. name: Downsizer Recommendations

Each offers walkability and proximity to shopping and healthcare. Would you like me to put together some specific listings?

name: Inspection Issues Guidance
templateText: Hi {{senderName}}, I understand your concern about the inspection results. With foundation issues, you have several options: 1) Request the seller make repairs before closing, 2) Negotiate a price reduction to account for repair costs, 3) Request a seller credit at closing, or 4) Exercise your inspection contingency to walk away. Given the severity of foundation issues, I'd recommend we discuss this in detail. Can we schedule a call to go over your options?

name: Listing Process Overview
templateText: Hi {{senderName}}! Excited to get started. name: Closing Costs Explanation
templateText: Hi {{senderName}}! Closing costs typically range from 2-5% of the purchase price for buyers and 6-10% for sellers (including agent commissions). Buyer costs include loan origination fees, appraisal, title insurance, and escrow fees. We provide a detailed estimate early in the process so there are no surprises. Would you like me to prepare a preliminary cost estimate based on your target price range?

name: Offer Strategy Discussion
templateText: Hi {{senderName}}! You can absolutely make an offer at any price.
